transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 384 Menora Lane?
Sí, soy yo en 384 Menora Lane. No hay agua dentro y estoy bien, no necesito ayuda.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?

Solo hay una persona en casa, y no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo.  
*(Corrección: Solo hay una persona en casa, y no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo.)*

Understood, one person is home and can leave alone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?

No, no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo.  
(Lo siento, corrijo: no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo, y no hay silla de ruedas ni necesidades especiales.)
Understood, no one needs assistance to leave. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua dentro de la casa. (Corrección: sí, hay agua dentro de la casa.)
Understood, you confirmed water is inside the home. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, no hay agua dentro de la casa. No tengo camión de gran altura, bote ni asientos libres en un vehículo para ayudar a vecinos.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 1 people; water is inside. Is that right?

Sí, una persona; no hay agua dentro.  
(Lo siento, corregido: no hay agua dentro.)
Gracias por confirmar la información. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
